name: office
description: Office productivity CLI plugin: wraps msgcli (email/calendar), jira-cli, gh, gws, agent-slack, and Obsidian CLI via intelligent skill routing. Provides office:email, office:calendar, office:jira, office:github, office:archive, office:organize, office:log-analyzer, office:personal-email, office:personal-calendar, office:slack, office:pulse, and office:morning-brief skills.
